data.title: 中野四叶 · 器材室黄昏的无声对视
data.description: 黄昏百叶窗将落日切成一道道金斑。昏暗的体育器材室角落里，两人距离近到能听见彼此的呼吸，四叶满脸通红、慌乱而真挚地凝视着少年。
data.action: leaning against gymnastics mats, slightly unzipped hoodie, blushing intensely
data.promptProse: Trapped in the dim sports locker room as sunset light filters through slatted window blinds, Nakano Yotsuba leans against stacked foam mats. Her athletic hoodie is slightly unzipped at the collar, and her chest heaves gently as she blushes furiously at the close distance.
data.animaCaption: Trapped in the golden twilight shadows of the equipment room, her heart races with a flustered blush.
